title: Honky Tonk Hideaway on Music Row
description:
Welcome to our Music Row Townhome! Our space is perfect for groups, families, and those wanting to explore everything Nashville has to offer. Located in Music Row, this home sleeps 6 people and is walking distance to some great bars, restaurants, and Nashville staples! 

☆ FREE PARKING (1 space). There is also street parking available.
☆ FREE Wifi 
☆ Large sofa lounge
☆ Smart TV's
☆ Full Kitchen 
☆ Washer & Dryer!

The space
Walk into a bright and inviting main floor with an open layout that makes relaxing and hosting feel natural. The living room is anchored by a large, comfortable sectional facing a smart TV. Perfect for kicking back after a day out.

The full kitchen is stocked with cooking supplies/utensils you'll need to prepare meals and spend time together. The adjacent dining area is great for everything from casual breakfasts to evening hangouts or games. Just off this space, you’ll find access to the back patio. An ideal place to step outside, get some fresh air, or unwind at the end of the day.

The half bath sits between the living area and kitchen. 

Upstairs, you will find the primary and secondary bedrooms. The primary bedroom has a queen bed, clothing storage, and smart TV. The secondary bedroom features two queen beds, a closet and a smart TV! 

The shared bathroom features a walk-in shower and sleek, modern fixtures, giving the space a clean and elevated feel.

The washer and dryer sits between the two bedrooms with an iron & ironing board! 

The townhouse suite is Unit #2 of 4 units on the property. Send us a message if you would like to book multiple units for your group!

→ There is construction happening next to the building currently - there may be construction noise during your stay

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire home during your stay! We are a 100% local team available 24/7 for anything you might need during your stay!

👶 Traveling with Little Ones?
Please note this home is not baby-proofed.

Other things to note
→ There is construction happening next to the building currently - there may be construction noise during your stay

→ Our team is available and on-call 24/7 for any emergency that may arise. Please reach out to our team directly if you need anything!  

→ No Saturday arrival or departures are allowed. 

→ Unit includes: 3 Queen beds, sleeps up to 6 people; Full kitchen with coffee maker, dishwasher, + ice maker 

→ Parking - there is 1 labeled parking spot available for the unit

→ Our quiet hours are 10 pm to 8 am. Please respect your noise levels. We have neighbors and ask that you be respectful of our home and theirs.

→ Check-in is at 4 pm // Check out is at 10 am. If you're looking to check in early or check out late, we suggest booking the night before or after your arrival. Otherwise, to be considerate of other guests, we cannot guarantee that early check-in or late check-out request will be accommodated. Feel free to arrive anytime after 4 pm.

→ After placing your booking you will receive a text from our team with a link to sign a form to confirm you've reviewed our house rules and ensure the check-in process go smoothly. We will send access info one day prior to arrival.
